metas.name: Albania - Tiranë mountains
metas.note: Tiranë has a big mountain range in the east, combined with gen 3 and double blue stripes on the license plates, 100% Tiranë.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/albania for more clues.

metas.name: Austria - Graz
metas.note: Graz street signs are green with white text.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/austria for more clues.

metas.name: Austria - Innsbruck
metas.note: Innsbruck street signs are very dark red/brown with white text.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/austria for more clues.

metas.name: Austria - Innsbruck Tape
metas.note: Poles in Vienna and Innsbruck feature these red-and-white pieces of tape that look like the Austrian flag. They can be differentiated by the fact that the tapes in Vienna are thinner, and there are typically two on each pole.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Austria - Linz
metas.note: Linz has these 2 different street signs, a black street sign with white text, and a unique street sign thats white with black text and has orange stripes above and under and an orange logo on the left.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/austria for more clues.

metas.name: Austria - Salzburg
metas.note: Salzburg street sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/austria for more clues.

metas.name: Austria - Vienna
metas.note: Vienna street sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/austria for more clues.

metas.name: Austria - Vienna Tape
metas.note: Poles in Vienna and Innsbruck feature these red-and-white pieces of tape that look like the Austrian flag. They can be differentiated by the fact that the tapes in Vienna are thinner, and there are typically two on each pole.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/austria.

metas.name: Belgium - Antwerp
metas.note: Antwerp street signs have the name Antwerpen written on them.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/belgium for more clues.

metas.name: Belgium - Brussels
metas.note: Brussels street signs have dutch and french written on them aswell as the city names on the top with a logo.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/belgium for more clues.

metas.name: Belgium - Ghent
metas.note: Ghent street signs have the name Gent written on them.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/belgium for more clues.

metas.name: Bulgaria - Plovdiv
metas.note: These 2 street signs can be found in Plovdiv, the left one is more common.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bulgaria for more clues.

metas.name: Bulgaria - Sofia
metas.note:
White street signs with two red strips; one covering the bottom and one covering part of the top, can be found in Sofia.

NOTE: You can also find other types of street signs in Sofia.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/bulgaria.

metas.name: Bulgaria - Stara Zagora street sign
metas.note: Brown street signs with bright yellow text can be found in Stara Zagora.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bulgaria for more clues.

metas.name: Croatia - Split
metas.note: Split, the 2nd biggest city in Croatia, is a distinct city surrounded by water, with big mountain ridges to the north and east. It has lots of big apartment buildings and 1 sky scraper which can sometimes be seen. An island can also sometimes be seen towards the west.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/croatia for more clues.

metas.name: Croatia - Zagreb street sign
metas.note: These 2 dark blue street signs are unique to Zagreb. It always has a white line next to the street name.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/croatia for more clues.

metas.name: Czechia - Brno house numbers
metas.note:
Pairs of black and white house numbers are found in Brno.

NOTE: The city district can be found written on the black house number.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/czechia.

metas.name: Czechia - České Budějovice street sign
metas.note: České Budějovice street signd are red and have the city name written on the bottom.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/czechia for more clues.

metas.name: Czechia - Plzeň house numbers
metas.note: Plzeň house numbers typically consist of two red and white octagonal plates with inverse colour schemes.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/czechia for more clues.

metas.name: Czechia - Prague street sign
metas.note: Prague street signs are very unique, they're red with a very unique and fancy looking frame around it. Their also big.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/czechia for more clues.

metas.name: Denmark - Aarhus street sign
metas.note: Aarhus has white street signs with blue text.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/denmark for more clues.

metas.name: Denmark - Copenhagen street sign
metas.note:
Within Denmark, Copenhagen has black street signs with white text.

NOTE: The centre of Odense also has black street signs with white text, but has a white frame added within it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/denmark for more clues.

metas.name: Denmark - Odense street signs
metas.note: Odense street signs are attached to a metal pole that has a 90° angle in it, be aware that these street sign poles can be found rarely in other towns on the island of Funen. But Odense has these spammed in every corner useally.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/denmark for more clues.

metas.name: Estonia - Tallinn street sign
metas.note: Tallinn street signs are blue with white text, often with a white with blue house number next to it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/estonia for more clues.

metas.name: Estonia - Tartu street sign
metas.note: Tartu street signs are black with white text and a white frame in it + the corners have dots.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/estonia for more clues.

metas.name: Finland - Helsinki street sign
metas.note: Helsinki street signs have 2 street signs on top of each other, they often have a unique font aswell.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/finland for more clues.

metas.name: Finland - Helsinki trams
metas.note:
Helsinki features these unique green-and-yellow trams.

NOTE: Tampere is the only other Finnish city with trams, but they are red instead of green and yellow.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/finland.

metas.name: Finland - Turku bus
metas.note: Buses in Turku are uniquely yellow, with a white rear.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/finland.

metas.name: France - Bordeaux street sign
metas.note: Small tables with “Arrᵗ” written on a small separate sign, are found in Bordeaux, despite being a city not divided into arrondissements.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/france.

metas.name: France - Lille street sign
metas.note: Street signs with a red slanted fleur-de-lis are unique to Lille.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/france.

metas.name: France - Lyon street sign
metas.note:
Lyon’s street signs feature four corner bolts and an uninterrupted inner white border that cuts a notch for the arrondissement and each bolt.

NOTE: Outside Lyon proper, the street sign will display the name of the suburb instead.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/france.

metas.name: France - Marseille street sign
metas.note: Marseille’s street signs will usually feature the city’s emblem, a variation of the Greek cross. The white border will usually be interrupted at the top, even when the cross is absent.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/france.

metas.name: France - Montpellier street sign
metas.note: Montpellier street signs will typically contain a blue ‘M’ on a white background in the top left corner.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/france.

metas.name: France - Nantes and Rennes street sign
metas.note: Nantes and Rennes have this street sign with the special corners and the dots in them. But Nantes is alot bigger so guessing Nantes would be the better option, unless you know its Rennes.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/france for more clues.

metas.name: France - Paris street sign
metas.note:
Paris uses an iconic green & Prussian blue design with a top arch that has also been replicated in Bucharest, which is sometimes referred to as Paris of the east.

NOTE: The simple rectangular form of the sign can be found in the towns nearby and rarely in other cities.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/france.

metas.name: France - Toulouse street sign
metas.note: Toulouse has these unique street signs.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/france for more clues.

metas.name: Germany - Berlin bin
metas.note: Berlin uses bright orange bins that have white text on them.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Berlin street sign
metas.note: Berlin uses white signs with a grey border, and a separate section for numbers under the street name. Also note how the letter ß looks.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Cologne Lamppost number
metas.note:
Lampposts in Cologne will often feature these bright yellow numbers on a black piece of plastic.

NOTE: Similar looking things can be found elsewhere as well.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Dortmund street sign
metas.note: Dortmund uses blue signs with a white border and a grey frame. The signs also have a separate section for numbers under the street name.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Dresden street sign
metas.note: Dresden has blue signs with a unique font.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Düsseldorf street sign
metas.note: Düsseldorf has black signs with a white border, similar to Munich. The signs have a metallic frame.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Essen street sign
metas.note: Essen has blue signs with a very thick metallic frame.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Frankfurt street sign
metas.note: Frankfurt uses blue street signs with a metallic border around the sign, as well as the separate section for numbers under the street name.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Hamburg bin
metas.note: Hamburg uses bright red bins, with white speech bubbles.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Leipzig street sign
metas.note: Leipzig street signs are blue with a white frame in it with fancy corners.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/germany for more clues.

metas.name: Germany - Munich street sign
metas.note: Munich has blue street signs with a white decorative border that does not touch the corners. Also note the unique font.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Nuremberg street sign
metas.note: Nuremberg has blue signs with a unique font. The signs also have a metal frame with a small gap between it and the sign.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Germany - Stuttgart street sign
metas.note: Stuttgart uses black signs without a border.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/germany.

metas.name: Greece - Athens street sign
metas.note: Athens has this street sign with an extra part under the main street sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/greece for more clues.

metas.name: Greece - Athens taxi
metas.note: Yellow taxis with a blue stripe around the taxi are found in Athens.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/greece.

metas.name: Greece - Thessaloniki tall antennas
metas.note: In Thessaloniki, you will often see a large amount of unusually tall antennas on top of buildings.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/greece.

metas.name: Greece - Thessaloniki taxi
metas.note: Blue taxis with a white roof are found in Thessaloniki.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/greece.

metas.name: Hungary - Budapest street sign
metas.note: Budapest street signs have a district number in roman numerals followed by ''Kerület''.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/hungary for more clues.

metas.name: Hungary - Győr street sign
metas.note: Győr has large diagional corners.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/hungary for more clues.

metas.name: Hungary - Kecskemét street sign
metas.note: Kecskemét has blue text with angular corners.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/hungary for more clues.

metas.name: Iceland - Reykjavik street sign
metas.note: This street sign is found everywhere in Iceland but Reykjavik is the only big city in Iceland, its an easy city to recognize within Iceland.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/iceland for more clues.

metas.name: Ireland - Cork vibes
metas.note: Cork is relatively unique in that it is significantly more hilly than the other big Irish cities.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/ireland.

metas.name: Ireland - Dublin street sign
metas.note: Dublin has blue street signs with white text and a white border around it, it also has a number on the right, showing in which district your in. Here is a map of postal areas in Dublin for guessing within the city.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ireland for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Bari street sign
metas.note: Bari street signs have this unique logo in the top left.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Bologna street sign
metas.note: Bologna street signs are white with blue text and a blue edge, the sign is sometimes supported by 3 small supports (1 on top, 2 on bottom).
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Florence street signs
metas.note: Florence street signs are supported by 3 small supports (1 on top, 2 on bottom).
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Milan street sign
metas.note: Milan street signs have a number in the top left.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Naples street sign
metas.note: Naples street signs have a unique font with an extra name under the street name.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Palermo Mountains
metas.note: Palermo has big mountains in the south and west.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Palermo street sign
metas.note: Palermo street signs have 4 dots in each corner.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Rome street sign
metas.note: Rome street signs are by far the most distinct street signs in Italy, their bigger than any other street sign in Italy, they have a very thick frame and the Roman numerals in the top right.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Turin street sign
metas.note: Turin street signs have this unique font, sometimes they also have the date of the years on the bottom.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/italy for more clues.

metas.name: Italy - Venice
metas.note: Venice can typically be recognized by its many canals running through most of the city.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/italy.

metas.name: Latvia - Riga street sign
metas.note: Riga street signs are dark blue or black with white text and a white frame and commonly end with iela.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/latvia for more clues.

metas.name: Latvia - Riga Transport
metas.note: Riga buses and trams are white with a blue bottom, VERY similar to the dutch ones.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/latvia for more clues.

metas.name: Lithuania - Kaunas house number
metas.note: Kaunas house numbers are very big, with curvy lines above and under the numbers.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/lithuania for more clues.

metas.name: Lithuania - Vilnius street sign
metas.note: Vilnius street signs are white with black text and a black frame in it. The house number has the same design and is often next to the street name.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/lithuania for more clues.

metas.name: Luxembourg - Luxembourg City street sign
metas.note: Luxembourg City has these unique street signs, the corners have blue triangle shapes.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/luxembourg for more clues.

metas.name: Netherlands - Amsterdam street sign
metas.note: Amsterdam street signs feature the city district in a smaller font size below the actual street name.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/netherlands.

metas.name: Netherlands - Rotterdam vibes
metas.note:
If you know your in The Netherlands, and you see many tall buildings, you will most likely be in Rotterdam. This city has the majority of skyscrapers within The Netherlands.

NOTE: The Hague and Amsterdam also have some tall buildings but not as much as Rotterdam.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/netherlands for more clues.

metas.name: North Macedonia - Skopje mountains
metas.note: Skopje has mountains in the north and south, the north mountain is even bigger and you can often see a cross on top of it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/north-macedonia for more clues.

metas.name: Norway - Bergen fire hydrant
metas.note: You can find this specific design of green fire hydrants in Bergen.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/norway.

metas.name: Norway - Oslo pole plates
metas.note: Fairly large black or red pole plates can be found in Oslo.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/norway.

metas.name: Norway - Stavanger red stripes
metas.note: Two red stripes going around lamp posts are commonly found in Stavanger.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/norway.

metas.name: Poland - Białystok street signs
metas.note: Białystok uses turquoise street signs, with the district marked on the bottom.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/poland.

metas.name: Poland - Bydgoszcz street sign
metas.note: Bydgoszcz street signs have a white frame in the sign with white dots in the corners.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: Poland - Częstochowa street sign
metas.note: Częstochowa street signs are blue with a yellow intersection on the bottom.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: Poland - Gdańsk street sign
metas.note: Gdańsk street signs have a brown intersection on the bottom.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: Poland - Katowice street sign
metas.note: Katowice street signs are black with yellow on the bottom, the city name is written in the yellow.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: Poland - Kraków street sign
metas.note: Kraków street signs are white with blue text and frame.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: Poland - Lublin street sign
metas.note: Lublin street signs are blue with a metal border around it, between the sign and the border is space.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: Poland - Poznań street sign
metas.note: Street signs in Poznań are mainly black, with the district being marked on the blue section at the bottom.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/poland.

metas.name: Poland - Szczecin street sign
metas.note: Szczecin uses colourful green and blue signs. The city district is marked on the bottom.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/poland.

metas.name: Poland - Warsaw/Łódź street sign
metas.note: Warsaw and Łódź street signs are either blue or brown, majority being blue, with a red part on the bottom that has the city district written on it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: poland - Wrocław street sign
metas.note: Wrocław street signs are either blue or brown, majority being blue, with a red part on the bottom that has the city district written on it, under the red part there is also a thick yellow stripe.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/poland for more clues.

metas.name: Portugal - Lisbon street sign
metas.note: Lisbon street signs have 4 big screws in each corner.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/portugal for more clues.

metas.name: Portugal - Porto street sign
metas.note: Lime green street signs can be found in Porto.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/portugal.

metas.name: Romania - Brașov mountain
metas.note: Brașov has a lush green mountain with 2 towers on top and has Brașov written on the right in white letters.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Romania - Bucharest street sign
metas.note: Bucharest has 2 different street signs, the most common one is the one on the bottom, its literally the same as the paris version but language will obviously tell the difference. The other one has the same colors and uses white arrows.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Romania - Buzău street sign
metas.note: Buzău street signs have an orange/blue B on the left, it also says the city name under it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Romania - Cluj-Napoca Transport
metas.note: Cluj-Napoca uses white and pink buses and white, pink and gray trams. The city name can be seen on the side of the buses.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Romania - Constanța street sign
metas.note: Constanța street signs have this unique orange shield logo on the left and above it is the city name written.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Romania - Timișoara taxi
metas.note: Timișoara taxis are white, which is not unique to Timișoara, but the purple sticker on the side is. It has municipiul Timișoara taxi written on the top of it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/romania for more clues.

metas.name: Russia - Kazan street sign
metas.note: Kazan has this extremely unique street sign.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Russia - Moscow street sign
metas.note: Moscow street signs are blue with white text, their bigger than any other russian city street sign and are commonly spread throughout the city. The house numbers are also as big and sometimes the street signs can have different shapes.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/russia for more clues.

metas.name: Russia - St Petersburg street sign
metas.note: St. Petersburg street signs include a transliteration of the street name on a black background with a unique logo on top with fancy borders. There is always another sign under it with a number written on in. They are primarily found downtown.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/russia.

metas.name: Serbia - Belgrade street sign
metas.note: Belgrade street signs have cyrillic and latin written on them, it also has a unique shield icon on the left which has the serbian flag colors in it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/serbia for more clues.

metas.name: Slovakia - Bratislava Transport
metas.note: Bratislava buses and trams are red.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/slovakia for more clues.

metas.name: Slovakia - Košice transport
metas.note: Košice has blue, yellow and white buses and trams.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/slovakia for more clues.

metas.name: Slovakia - Žilina buses and poles
metas.note: Trolleybuses in Žilina use a green-yellow-white colour scheme. The trolley supporting electricity poles, often doubling as lamps, are painted with matching yellow and green colours.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/slovakia.

metas.name: Slovenia - Ljubljana street sign
metas.note: Ljubljana street signs are green with a white fancy frame in it, the house numbers in Ljubljana are also green.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/slovenia for more clues.

metas.name: Spain - Barcelona taxi
metas.note: Taxis in Barcelona are black with yellow doors, including the trunk door.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/spain.

metas.name: Spain - Bilbao street sign
metas.note: The city of Bilbao uses this unique street sign, with a very elaborately decorated frame.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/spain.

metas.name: Spain - Madrid street sign
metas.note: Madrid has 2 different kinds of street signs, the bottom one, found in the centre, is a very unique street sign, every street sign has a different picture shown. The street sign above is found outside of its centre, its blue with white text, but has a very important logo on the left, looks like a crown on top of something. There are a few slightly different versions of this crown logo throughout this city. So make sure to look if there is a crown on top of the logo.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/spain for more clues.

metas.name: Spain - Murcia street sign
metas.note: Murcia street signs are blue with this thick white edge and have this unique logo on the left with a crown.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/spain for more clues.

metas.name: Spain - Seville street sign
metas.note: Seville street signs are pretty unique, each individual name has its own section with this unique font.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/spain for more clues.

metas.name: Spain - Velencia street sign
metas.note: Velencia street signs have this unique logo on the top left.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/spain for more clues.

metas.name: Spain - Zaragoza street sign
metas.note: Zaragoza street signs are white with a unique logo in the top left and also has a fancy decorated blue frame, they kinda look like many leaves.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/spain for more clues.

metas.name: Sweden - Gothenburg street sign
metas.note:
The entire city of Gothenburg uses these unique blue street signs. Note that they almost always have two lines.

NOTE: Some other cities will have blue street signs near the centre, however they use a different design.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/sweden.

metas.name: Sweden - Malmö street sign
metas.note: These somewhat old-looking, white street signs, with black corners, can be found all throughout Malmö.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/sweden.

metas.name: Sweden - Stockholm street sign
metas.note:
Street signs in Stockholm will have two rows divided by a black line and will usually lack a black border. Similar signs can also rarely be found in central Gävle.

NOTE: Several suburbs in Stockholm use plain white street signs.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/sweden.

metas.name: Switzerland - Basel street sign
metas.note: Large blue street signs, attached to a low double signpost, similar to directional signs in Denmark, are found in Basel.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/switzerland.

metas.name: Switzerland - Geneva street sign
metas.note:
If you know your in Switzerland and you see these dark blue street signs with Rue written on it, The only city that has these is Geneva.

NOTE: This design can commonly be found in France so make sure to confirm your in switzerland.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/switzerland for more clues.

metas.name: Switzerland - Zurich street sign
metas.note: Zurich street signs are blue with a white edge and 4 thick dots in each corner.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/switzerland for more clues.

metas.name: Turkey - Ankara street sign
metas.note:
Street signs in the Ankara Province are blue with a small round top. Similar street signs can very rarely be found in Giresun.

Beware that some newer street signs are red.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/turkey for more clues.

metas.name: Turkey - Antalya Mountains
metas.note: Antalya has a huge mountain range in the west, sometimes snow can be seen on top of it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/turkey for more clues.

metas.name: Turkey - Antalya street sign
metas.note: Antalya street signs are very simillar to the istanbul version, except that the Antalya version has a rounded logo in the bottom left.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/turkey for more clues.

metas.name: Turkey - Bursa street sign
metas.note:
Street signs in Bursa are green, and generally have slightly extruded letters, meaning the signs are not completely flat.

NOTE: Several other types of infrastructure in Bursa, such as fences and guardrails, may also be coloured green.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/turkey.

metas.name: Turkey - Eskişehir street sign
metas.note: Eskişehir has 2 street signs, both blue, but the one on top has 2 white lines on the top and bottom. The bottom one has 3 intersections with text in each one. The street sign on the top is more common.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/turkey for more clues.

metas.name: Turkey - Gaziantep street sign
metas.note: Gaziantep street signs are blue and oval shaped with a white edge inside it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/turkey for more clues.

metas.name: Turkey - Istanbul street sign
metas.note:
Red street signs with a coloured bottom strip are found in several cities. In the bottom right corner, you can find a white arrow and some numbers. If this arrow is pointing in both directions and has a single arrowhead, rather than double, then you are almost certainly in Istanbul.

Beware that simple arrows pointing in only one direction can be found in both Istanbul and in other cities. However, if you see such signs in combination with red house numbers, then you should be in Istanbul.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/turkey.

metas.name: Turkey - Izmir street sign
metas.note: Street signs in the Izmir Province are dark blue, noticeably bulge outwards and very commonly have the emblem of Izmir in white at the top of the sign.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/turkey.

metas.name: Ukraine - Donetsk coverage
metas.note:
Donetsk and Odesa are the only 2 cities that only have 2011 coverage, all the coverage within those cities is taken in the autumn, which means you will see many orange and yellow leaves on the trees. Donetsk has long antenna, Odesa has short antenna.

NOTE: Kyiv, Lviv and Kharkiv also have autumn coverage but the majority has been overwritten by the newer summer coverage so you will rarely see those cities in autumn aswell.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ukraine for more clues.

metas.name: Ukraine - Kharkiv street sign
metas.note: Kharkiv street signs are blue with a white line in the middle, top text is written in cyrillic and the bottom is written in latin. The house numbers also have the same design.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ukraine for more clues.

metas.name: Ukraine - Kryvyi Rih poles
metas.note: These poles, with a red band across them, are unique to Kryvyi Rih.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/ukraine.

metas.name: Ukraine - Kyiv vibes
metas.note: If you know your in Ukraine, and you see many large and tall buildings, your most likely in Kyiv.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ukraine for more clues.

metas.name: Ukraine - Lviv streets and street sign
metas.note: Lviv streets have unique cobblestone pavement which really isnt found anywhere else in Ukraine except some smaller cities in the far west. It also has a unique street sign with a castel logo on the left which you can use to confirm Lviv.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ukraine for more clues.

metas.name: Ukraine - Odesa coverage
metas.note:
Donetsk and Odesa are the only 2 cities that only have 2011 coverage, all the coverage within those cities is taken in the autumn, which means you will see many orange and yellow leaves on the trees. Donetsk has long antenna, Odesa has short antenna.

NOTE: Kyiv, Lviv and Kharkiv also have autumn coverage but the majority has been overwritten by the newer summer coverage so you will rarely see those cities in autumn aswell.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/ukraine for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Aberdeen architecture
metas.note: Aberdeen is a very easy recognizable city, 99% of all buildings are made out of grey sandstone.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Belfast mountains
metas.note:
Depending where you are in Belfast, you can often see these mountains with lots of trees on it (gets more bald on the top) to the west/north-west, sometimes with 1 or 2 towers on top of it. Hills can also be seen in the east/south east.

If your not sure these mountains are the Belfast mountains, check for clues to confirm your in Northern Ireland and it will 100% be Belfast.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Birmingham yellow tape/paint
metas.note: The majority of poles and signposts in Birmingham have either yellow tape or yellow paint wrapped around them. Lampposts will also usually have this yellow sticker.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Bristol street sign
metas.note: Street signs in Bristol will always have ''BS'' with a number written on the right side. This one is easy to remember because BS stands for Bri-Stol.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Edinburgh architecture
metas.note:
Edinburgh buildings are mostly made out of yellow/brown sandstone.

NOTE: Glasgow also has yellow/brown sandstone but also has red sandstone buildings.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Glasgow pink sticker + architecture
metas.note: This pink sticker with the text ''PEOPLE MAKE GLASGOW'' can be found on these trash bins in Glasgow. The buildings in Glasgow are also made of red sandstone and yellow sandstone.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Greater Manchester bus stop sign
metas.note:
This busstop sign can be found in Greater Manchester, it has the phone code on it and the M logo on the top left corner with a bunch of other things like a bee on the right. The logo's and phone code can only be seen on one side.

NOTE: A different version can be seen in older coverage, which will be completely white with a huge M logo on it.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Leeds street sign
metas.note: Street signs in Leeds District will always have ''LS'' with a number written on the right side. This one is easy to remember because LS stands for Leed-S. The street sign in the top left is only found in the center.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - Liverpool street sign
metas.note: Liverpool street signs often an L on the bottom right corner, standing for Liverpool, towards the centre in the city you will get signs with a unique shape and often have the text ''City of Liverpool'' written on them.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom for more clues.

metas.name: United Kingdom - London street sign
metas.note: London street signs have a distinct look. They usually feature the street name in black, followed by the postcode and borough in red.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/united-kingdom.
